title: Pilate Stone
summary: A Latin inscription naming Pontius Pilate and documenting Roman administration in Judea.
historical_context: Confirms the historical name and title of Pilate as prefect in Judea.
ancient_near_east_context: The item belongs to the broader imperial, cultic, and urban world of the ancient Near East and the biblical periods reflected in the dataset.
literary_context: A key artifact for the historical setting of the Passion narratives.
covenantal_significance: Pilate Stone helps anchor biblical claims in historical reality while reminding readers that archaeology supports rather than replaces interpretation.
interpretive_notes: The inscription is clear, but it does not by itself explain Pilate's actions in the Gospels.
Use the item as context for the biblical text, not as a shortcut around it.
